projects-interface__description-jacacult: Cultural events tracker for Jacarei, developed as a course thesis project
projects-interface__description-zminicha: Blockchain simulation with its own REST API layer
about__summary: I enjoy transforming ideas into services, APIs, and simple, well-structured, and maintainable tools. My focus is on backend development, Computer Science fundamentals, and systems programming, always aiming to understand how software works beyond abstractions.
about__fact-focus: Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Python
about__fact-learning: Learning Go, systems programming, and backend architecture
project-detail__jacacultmap-summary: A mobile cultural map for exploring and sharing cultural points, events, spaces, and local information in Jacarei.
project-detail__jacacultmap-overview: JacacultMap was built as an integrator project for IFSP. Its goal is to make local culture easier to discover from a phone, using an interactive map and a backend that stores cultural points.
project-detail__jacacultmap-feature-1: Filters for event and place categories such as museums, theaters, concerts, and exhibitions.
project-detail__jacacultmap-feature-2: Search by cultural point name or location.
project-detail__jacacultmap-feature-3: User flow for registering and updating cultural points.
project-detail__jacacultmap-feature-4: Responsive interface optimized for Android and iOS.
project-detail__zminichain-summary: A blockchain fundamentals project split into a framework-free Java API and a TypeScript React Router app for testing and visualization.
project-detail__zminichain-overview: ZMiniChain focuses on learning JVM internals, improving Java proficiency, and implementing core blockchain concepts without hiding the HTTP layer behind Spring or external frameworks.
project-detail__zminichain-feature-1: Pure Java blockchain API with custom request, response, REST annotation, and server code.
project-detail__zminichain-feature-2: Block model calculates SHA-256 hashes from transactions, world state, timestamp, nonce, previous hash, and index.
project-detail__zminichain-feature-3: Genesis account and ledger state are created when the chain starts.
project-detail__zminichain-feature-4: React Router app includes API-testing screens and Docker deployment setup.
